# Wash 66

> Wash 66 is a soft-touch express exterior car wash at 7 Pettingill Road, Quispamsis, NB E2E 6B1, Canada. It offers single washes, unlimited monthly memberships (one wash per day) using an RFID windshield tag, auto detailing by appointment, and covered vacuum bays. Open every day 8 am to 7 pm, holidays 10 am to 6 pm, closed Christmas Day. Phone 506-847-7627, email info@wash66.com.

## Washes and prices (CAD)

- Good: $14.95 per wash (HST included), or $36 + HST per month as a membership
- Better: $18.40 per wash (HST included), or $39 + HST per month as a membership
- Best: $21.85 per wash (HST included), or $44 + HST per month as a membership
- 3 months paid up front (plus HST): Good $85, Better $94, Best $107
- Best membership, buy 6 months and get the 7th free: $262 + HST
- Vacuums are free with any wash or membership, $5 on their own
- Height clearance at the tunnel entrance: 7'2" (2.18 m). Most cars, SUVs and pickups fit; roof boxes, tall racks and very tall lifted trucks may not

## What each wash includes

- Good: pre-soak, wheel cleaner, soft-touch wash, spot-free rinse, drying agent and dryers
- Better: everything in Good, plus triple shine foam, undercarriage rinse with rust inhibitor and clear coat protectant
- Best: everything in Better, plus premium protectant and premium wax

## Auto detailing (book ahead, prices plus HST)

- Package 1, $60: Good wash, towel dry, interior vacuum. Add the interior (wipe-down and floor mats) for $30
- Package 2, $110: Better wash, towel dry, acid-cleaned rims, interior vacuum, door jambs, floor mats. Add interior dressing for $25
- Package 3, $150: Best wash, towel dry, acid-cleaned rims, interior and trunk vacuumed, interior cleaned and dressed, door and trunk jambs, floor mats, spray wax, windows cleaned, tires dressed

## Gift cards

- Sold at the wash in any amount; good for washes, memberships and detailing
- Bonus value: a $60 gift card for $50, or a $125 gift card for $100
- More value can be added to the same card any time
- Check a balance at https://www.worldgiftcard.com/cardholder.htm

## Membership terms

- One vehicle per membership; anyone driving the tagged vehicle can use it
- Valid one month from the date of purchase and renews automatically
- Cancelling needs at least 20 days' notice before the billing date; changes are made on site
- One wash per day maximum
